title: WHAT SHALL I RENDER?
A PRAYER OF THANKS
end: The Praise Garden — enter His gates with thanksgiving
stock_queries: golden sunlight through morning forest trees
calm meadow river soft morning light
golden sunset over calm river water
soft morning sunlight over green hills

scenes.a: Your hands are full of unmerited mercy today.
When you look back over what God has done, the heart quietly asks:
What shall I render unto the LORD for all his benefits toward me?
scenes.sub: WHAT SHALL I RENDER UNTO THE LORD

scenes.a: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.
scenes.sub: I WILL TAKE THE CUP OF SALVATION

scenes.a: Father, we cannot repay Your kindness. We do not bring gifts to buy Your favor;
we simply lift up the cup You filled and call upon Your holy name with thankful praise.
scenes.sub: LIFTING UP THE CUP HE FILLED

scenes.a: Teach us to receive Your daily grace with open hands, trusting Your goodness in every season. Amen. Your hands are full of mercy.
